newsitem.title: USA: N.J. Transit plans $140 mln upgrade -- paper.
newsitem.headline: N.J. Transit plans $140 mln upgrade -- paper.

text.p: NJ Transit plans to spend $140 million to become the first railroad in the nation with a new train-stopping device, the Bergen Record reported Monday.
The radio-based device, which the newspaper said could have prevented a fatal 1996 accident, is expected to win approval at an August 14 board meeting.
The transit system planned to install the safety improvements on a more gradual timetable, but decided to speed up the plan after the 1996 accident.
The technology uses transponders and on-board train computers to automatically stop and slow trains.
